config.label: BMP280 (I2C temperature/pressure)
config.notes: Bosch BMP280 barometric pressure and temperature sensor on I2C. Add it as a device in the Devices document (it initialises the sensor at the chosen address in setup), then read values with the actions.

actions.label: Read temperature (°C)
actions.notes: Reads the temperature in degrees Celsius into a new float variable.

actions.label: Read pressure (Pa)
actions.notes: Reads the air pressure in pascals into a new float variable (divide by 100 for hPa).
